title: Why Vulpix Breathes Fire on Hot Days
premise: Vulpix releases flames from its mouth on hot days to prevent its body from growing too hot.
audiencePromise: Learn how Vulpix uses mouth flames to prevent its body from growing too hot.
openLoop: Why would Vulpix spit out its own endless flame?
payoff: On hot days, Vulpix releases flames from its mouth to prevent its body from growing too hot.
engagementQuestion: Is Vulpix mainly a heat regulator or fireball maker?

voice.instructions: Use a quick, curious pace. Stress the contradiction between rising heat and released flames. Pause before the payoff, then present the final choice clearly.

scenes.caption: WHY RELEASE ITS OWN FIRE?

scenes.headline: THE FLAME NEVER GOES OUT
scenes.narration: Inside Vulpix burns a flame that never goes out.

scenes.headline: DAYTIME HEAT TRIGGERS RELEASE
scenes.narration: As daytime temperatures rise, Vulpix releases flames from its mouth.
scenes.caption: HEAT RISES. FLAMES STREAM OUT.

scenes.headline: THE RELEASE PREVENTS OVERHEATING
scenes.narration: That release prevents Vulpix's body from growing too hot.
scenes.caption: PREVENTS THE BODY FROM GETTING TOO HOT

scenes.headline: FIRE GOES OUTWARD ON HOT DAYS

scenes.caption: INNER FIRE → OUTWARD FLAMES
